newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.315 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.315 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended July 12 was 4,315,344 gallons compared with 3,575,210 gallons last week.
Imports were 135,240 gallons compared with 824,344 gallons the previous week. There were 464 domestic receipts for this week compared with none last week.
Retail movement was 753,953 gallons, while bulk movement was 2,920,270 gallons.
The net cumulative pack for the season is 242,268,243 gallons.
